lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters are organized into three primary vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. The centroids follow a semi-rectilinear grid, with the most intense local maxima located in the mid-lateral section, approximately 400-600 pixels posterior to the fifth branchial aperture.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with horizontal rows of spots to form a matrix. These vertical bands are most prominent between the dorsal ridges, where spots are positioned as anchor nodes within the lighter vertical regions.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two distinct horizontal ridges are visible. The superior ridge exhibits a sharp pixel intensity gradient with high-luminance values on the dorsal aspect and a pronounced shadow on the ventral aspect, maintaining a trajectory parallel to the midline of the visible flank.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin, visible in the lower right quadrant, displays a distinct transition in spot morphology: large, discrete circular clusters at the proximal base transitioning to a high-density field of significantly smaller, lower-intensity pixel clusters towards the distal margin.
